answer.sql:
SELECT
    pa.Effective_Date AS coverage_start_date,
    pa.Policy_Amount AS annual_premium,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (pa.Policy_Amount - LAG(pa.Policy_Amount) OVER (ORDER BY pa.Effective_Date))
        / LAG(pa.Policy_Amount) OVER (ORDER BY pa.Effective_Date),
        2
    ) AS pct_change_from_previous
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_amount pa
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
JOIN premium pr
    ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
ORDER BY pa.Effective_Date;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-5 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15 miles'
    ELSE 'more than 15 miles'
  END AS distance_band,
  COUNT(*) AS number_of_claims,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
GROUP BY distance_band
ORDER BY MIN(Nearest_Firestation_miles);

answer.sql:
SELECT CORR(Number_of_Firefighters, Loss_Ratio) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM fire_claim;

WITH pa AS (
  SELECT pa.Effective_Date, pa.Policy_Amount
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium p ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN policy pol ON pol.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
  WHERE pol.Policy_Number = 31003000336
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT Policy_Amount FROM pa ORDER BY Effective_Date ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_amount,
    (SELECT Effective_Date FROM pa ORDER BY Effective_Date ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_date,
    (SELECT Policy_Amount FROM pa ORDER BY Effective_Date DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_amount,
    (SELECT Effective_Date FROM pa ORDER BY Effective_Date DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_date
)
SELECT
  POWER(last_amount * 1.0 / first_amount, 1.0 / DATE_DIFF('year', first_date, last_date)) - 1 AS cagr
FROM first_last;

SELECT Number_of_Firefighters, AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS avg_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
GROUP BY Number_of_Firefighters
ORDER BY avg_loss_ratio ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  MEDIAN(CASE WHEN Year_Built >= 2000 THEN Loss_Ratio END) AS median_loss_ratio_2000_or_later,
  MEDIAN(CASE WHEN Year_Built < 2000 THEN Loss_Ratio END) AS median_loss_ratio_before_2000
FROM fire_claim;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  DATE_DIFF('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Open_Date) AS days_incident_to_open,
  DATE_DIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS days_open_to_close,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * DATE_DIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)
    / NULLIF(DATE_DIFF('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date), 0),
    2
  ) AS pct_time_open
FROM claim c
JOIN occurrences o ON c.Occurrence_Identifier = o.Occurrence_Identifier;

WITH incurred_losses AS (
  SELECT SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN claim c ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date BETWEEN DATE '2019-01-01' AND DATE '2019-12-31'
    AND ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
      SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
      UNION
      SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    )
),
earned_premium AS (
  SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium p ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  WHERE pa.Effective_Date BETWEEN DATE '2019-01-01' AND DATE '2019-12-31'
)
SELECT
  incurred_losses.total_loss,
  earned_premium.total_premium,
  CAST(incurred_losses.total_loss AS DOUBLE) / earned_premium.total_premium AS loss_ratio_2019
FROM incurred_losses, earned_premium;

SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name,
  COALESCE(lp.total_loss_payment, 0) + COALESCE(lr.total_loss_reserve, 0) AS total_loss,
  COALESCE(ep.total_expense_payment, 0) + COALESCE(er.total_expense_reserve, 0) AS total_expense,
  CASE
    WHEN (COALESCE(lp.total_loss_payment, 0) + COALESCE(lr.total_loss_reserve, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (COALESCE(ep.total_expense_payment, 0) + COALESCE(er.total_expense_reserve, 0))
         / (COALESCE(lp.total_loss_payment, 0) + COALESCE(lr.total_loss_reserve, 0)) * 100
  END AS expense_pct_of_loss
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat
  ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_payment
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) lp ON lp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_reserve
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) lr ON lr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_expense_payment
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) ep ON ep.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_expense_reserve
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) er ON er.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_to_reserved_ratio
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier;

WITH incurred_amounts AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
),
coverage_loss AS (
    SELECT cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, SUM(ia.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
    FROM claim_coverage cc
    JOIN incurred_amounts ia ON ia.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
coverage_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Start_Date,
    cp.premium AS Premium,
    cl.incurred_loss AS Incurred_Loss,
    cl.incurred_loss / cp.premium AS Loss_Ratio
FROM policy_coverage_detail pcd
JOIN policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN coverage_loss cl ON cl.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN coverage_premium cp ON cp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier;

WITH agents AS (
  SELECT
    apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    p.Party_Identifier,
    per.First_Name,
    per.Last_Name
  FROM agreement_party_role apr
  JOIN party_role pr ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
  JOIN party p ON apr.Party_Identifier = p.Party_Identifier
  JOIN person per ON p.Party_Identifier = per.Person_Identifier
  WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name = 'Agent'
),
premiums AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
losses AS (
  SELECT
    pcd.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
  FROM policy_coverage_detail pcd
  JOIN claim_coverage cc ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  JOIN claim c ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
  a.First_Name,
  a.Last_Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.Policy_Identifier) AS num_policies_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(p.total_premium), 0) AS total_premium,
  COALESCE(SUM(l.total_loss), 0) AS total_loss_paid
FROM agents a
LEFT JOIN premiums p ON a.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN losses l ON a.Policy_Identifier = l.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY a.Party_Identifier, a.First_Name, a.Last_Name;

WITH claim_zip AS (
    SELECT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        la.Postal_Code,
        c.Claim_Open_Date,
        c.Claim_Close_Date
    FROM claim c
    JOIN insurable_object io
        ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    JOIN geographic_location gl
        ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    JOIN location_address la
        ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
),
claim_costs AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_cost
    FROM claim_amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cz.Postal_Code,
    SUM(cc.total_cost) AS total_claim_cost,
    AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', cz.Claim_Open_Date, cz.Claim_Close_Date)) AS avg_days_open_to_close
FROM claim_zip cz
LEFT JOIN claim_costs cc
    ON cz.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cz.Postal_Code;

    ON prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier

answer.sql:
WITH incurred_loss AS (
    SELECT
        c.Insurable_Object_Identifier AS io_id,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_incurred_loss
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN claim c ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
    GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
total_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier AS io_id,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_charged
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium p ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier
)
SELECT
    la.Line_1_Address,
    il.total_incurred_loss / tp.premium_charged AS incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio
FROM incurred_loss il
JOIN total_premium tp ON il.io_id = tp.io_id
JOIN insurable_object io ON il.io_id = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN geographic_location gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN location_address la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
ORDER BY incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio DESC;
